[{"insert":"Goblet Squat Progression

The goblet squat completes the cycle at 20 reps per set, the highest rep count of the block. High rep squats test your legs and your ability to keep pushing when tired. Brace hard at the top of every rep before you drop. The goal is the same depth and speed on rep twenty as on rep one.
"}]
